ScoreRun.title: ScoreRun
ScoreRun.description: Immutable single-run submission record used to deduplicate runs by runId and verify score integrity atomically.

runId.description: Unique client-generated run identifier matching the document ID.

userId.description: Firebase Anonymous Auth UID of the submitting player.

tagCode.description: Short 4-char public discriminator code derived from UID hash.

ruleVersion.description: Game ruleset version isolating incompatible scoring versions.

score.description: Total score matching distanceMeters + normalCount*10 + goldenCount*50 (0..5314).

cleared.description: Whether Songi arrived at Snowflower Plaza.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public best-score record for one anonymous user in a specific game rule version. Contains no PII or auth tokens.

userId.description: Internal Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID (never rendered publicly in UI).

tagCode.description: Short 4-char discriminator code for identical nicknames.

tieBreaker.description: Stable deterministic tie-breaking key derived from UID hash.

score.description: Personal best score (0..5314), strictly monotonic on updates.

normalCount.description: Normal snowflakes from the best-score run (0..231).

goldenCount.description: Golden snowflakes from the best-score run (0..32).

distanceMeters.description: Distance in meters from the best-score run (0..1404).

cleared.description: Whether the best-score run cleared Snowflower Plaza.

bestRunId.description: Run ID of the ScoreRun document that established this best score.

achievedAt.description: Server timestamp when this personal best score was first achieved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest document update.

lastSubmittedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest high-score submission for cooldown enforcement.

/score_runs/{runId}.description: Immutable per-run submission log keyed by unique runId for deduplication and atomic leaderboard verification.

/leaderboard_v1_course_5314/{userId}.description: Public realtime leaderboard for rule version v1_course_5314, storing each anonymous user's single best record.
